parsed.post: Keeping the recent run (0.9893). It seems my previous attempt to reduce batch size was unsuccessful, but this configuration is actually better than my previous best (0.9955). Since the capacity trend (ASPECT_RATIO) and the lower LR trend (MATRIX_LR) are both showing promise, I will combine them: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 and lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.05.
parsed.description: Combining capacity increase (ASPECT_RATIO 48->64) with lower learning rate (MATRIX_LR 0.06->0.05) to see if the width and LR improvements are synergistic.
